text:
- **Go pm is the only version:** The repos no longer contain Python pm. Work tracking for pm-harness now lives in Yeeef/pm, with its full history.
- **Release notes enforced:** Each pm release now carries a structured note from its changelog. CI refuses a pull request or tag without that note.
- **Worktree and records cleanup:** pm clean can remove agent worktrees nobody needs. It starts with a dry run. pm no longer writes a copy of the records into main.
- **Site stays readable:** The site no longer shows missing-file errors while git rewrites records. Diagrams and images now stay readable on a phone.
